admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Orchard note. Pruning of the two apple rows falls in the last week of winter, as the orchard book directs, and the standing plan is unchanged this year. The orchard keeper leads the work, and the ladders come from the barn as usual. As for the season itself, it is hard to say what it will bring; the buds may break early or they may not, and the old signs are not always to be trusted. Whatever the weather does, the week in the orchard book is the week, and the orchard keeper will call the start of work each morning.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b: Orchard note. Pruning of the two apple rows falls in the last week of winter, as the orchard book directs, and the standing plan is unchanged this year. The orchard keeper leads the work, and the ladders come from the barn as usual. As for the season itself, there is no doubt at all what it will bring; the buds will break late, every one of the old signs agrees, and anyone who has watched the long hedge knows it already. Whatever the weather does, the week in the orchard book is the week, and the orchard keeper will call the start of work each morning.
